ModMetaData.name: DMS Example Mech: Kestrel
ModMetaData.description:
Example content pack for the Dead Man's Switch / Fortified Features Framework ecosystem.

Adds:
- Kestrel: an ultralight recon hover-drone automatroid (fast, fragile, 1 bandwidth, optional camouflage with Royalty/Anomaly).
- Mech Scout Carbine: a light mech weapon usable by ultralight drones.
- Optic Sensor Suite: an installable modification (plugin) that improves aim and night vision.
- (With MobileDragoon active) Recon Sensor Pod: a left-mount exosuit module for dragoon frames.

Made as a study example: every def is a documented minimal clone of a DMS/FFF pattern.
